report.rationale: Circulation_loss is the only candidate compatible with all three independent diagnostic channels. All five noisy independent repeats agree. E17 and E11 disfavor actuator_stiction, the strongest alternative; the other channels disfavor sensor_bias and controller_timing_fault. Probabilities reflect strong agreement but are approximate because channel error rates were not supplied.

Circulation_loss is the unique candidate compatible with all three primary channels, E18, E09, and E17, and all five acquired independent noisy repeats agree. No acquired evidence contradicts it. The repeats reinforce existing signature bits rather than add distinct signature constraints. Under comparable priors and error rates, actuator_stiction is the strongest alternative: it conflicts with E17 and E11, while sensor_bias and controller_timing_fault each conflict with three observations. Unknown priors and error rates prevent posterior calibration; the numerical probabilities are heuristic confidence allocations, not established error bounds.
